title: Green Kills You
description: steping on green blocks will kill you (Happy ST Patrick's Day)
body:
🟩 GreenKill

Touch green. Die instantly.

GreenKill is a brutal challenge mod that turns Minecraft’s most common color into your greatest enemy.

💀 Features

🟢 Instant death on contact with green blocks

Any part of your hitbox touching green = death

Includes dyed blocks, vegetation, leaves, moss, emerald blocks, oxidized copper, and more

🧟 Green mobs are lethal

Touch a “green” mob → instant death

⚡ No escape mechanics

Damage is instant and unavoidable

No armor, no resistance, no second chances
